items.title: CrowdStrike is spending $43.9 billion to buy Zscaler in a huge cybersecurity deal as tech outages spread
items.summary: A big deal in cybersecurity has hit.

items.title: CrowdStrike CEO Sees $185B Opportunity, Says Zscaler Deal Will Create A ‘Winning Combination’ Amid Rising AI Threats
items.summary: CrowdStrike co-founder and CEO George Kurtz said that the tailwinds from the deal and the feedback from customers reiterated that its Zscaler acquisition would create “a winning combination.”

items.title: Nvidia Just Built Agent Security Into Its Chips. What Does That Mean for CrowdStrike?
items.summary: A brief mention on Nvidia’s earnings call hints at a bigger role for CrowdStrike in securing AI agents.

items.title: CrowdStrike's $43.9 billion deal has a surprising catch
items.summary: Zscaler investors get a premium, but existing shareholders face a different calculation.

items.title: CrowdStrike (CRWD) Stock Price Drops As Q3 Results Revive Margin Debate
items.summary: CrowdStrike stock took a hit after its Q3 FY2027 report, falling about 9% to US$208.97, even though the quarter delivered record cybersecurity scale. The headline was clear. Revenue reached US$1.58b and net new annual recurring revenue of US$419m pushed total recurring commitments to US$6.26b. Short term traders focused on the sharp pullback. Longer horizon investors may focus on that recurring revenue engine and its implications for cash generation over the next several years, particularly...

items.title: Palo Alto Has “a Really Good Chance of Being a Trillion Dollar Business,” Says Chamath. Here’s What It Takes
items.summary: Key TakeawaysChamath Palihapitiya says Palo Alto Networks could become a trillion-dollar business within a decade, more than triple its market value. Analysts see revenue growth around 15% a year after this fiscal year, and the stock trades at 79x forward earnings, against a five-year average of 57x.

items.title: Why CrowdStrike Stock Was Down Today
items.summary: CrowdStrike beat Wall Street's estimates, but its $43.9 billion deal to buy Zscaler sent the stock lower.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: Nvidia, Anthropic, Zscaler
items.summary: ↗️ Nvidia (NVDA): Shares of the chip maker soared 31% on Monday after the company said it had reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following intense pressure from Silicon Valley, Wall Street investors and the White House.
